status_note: This file specifies a target schema. It is not implemented anywhere and must not be read by production code yet.

market.name: Jiangsu day-ahead energy market (distribution-network equivalent)
market.period_indexing: 1..96, covering 00:15-24:00, each label is the interval END time

participant.role_mismatch_note: Jiangsu admits grid-side storage stations. The project's four 0.4 MW units at buses 9/14/17/27 are not stations and their market admission is unverified.

unknowns.note: No Jiangsu storage segment-count limit was obtained. The generator limit of 10 segments must not be reused.
Whether Jiangsu requires declared SOC bounds, minimum charge/discharge duration or end-of-day SOC target is unverified. Other provinces' fields must not be transplanted.
Voluntary participation, irrevocable once joined. Modelled as already joined.

numerical_instance_for_this_project.derived: with a 0.1 MW minimum step and a 0.4 MW rated power, a curve can carry at most 4 segments

action_projection_from_rl.note: How a learned policy's raw action becomes a valid bid. Specification only.

raw_action_example.name: two_knot_curve
raw_action_example.constraint: price_at_rated >= price_at_zero for each direction (monotonicity by construction)
raw_action_example.segments_recovered: 4 segments of 0.1 MW each, linearly interpolated and rounded to the nearest valid step
raw_action_example.why_four_parameters: the two-knot family is the smallest family that can express a non-flat monotone curve and still satisfy the 0.1 MW step rule

rejected_alternative.name: single_price_per_direction
rejected_alternative.reason: expressible as a curve only when flat; cannot represent offering more at a higher price, which is what the rule's monotonicity is for

settlement_interface.price_source: dual of the nodal active-power balance in the distribution clearing, divided by the period length
settlement_interface.sign_convention: positive price means energy delivered to the feeder is paid that amount
settlement_interface.cash_settlement: sum over periods of dt * nodal_price * (discharge - charge)
settlement_interface.evidence_note: The structure follows R-34 and R-35 in general terms. No Jiangsu storage-specific day-ahead settlement formula was obtained (R-49).

validation_rules: every segment width is a multiple of 0.1 MW
segment prices are non-decreasing within a curve
the first segment starts at 0 MW and the last ends at the rated power
no segment price lies outside [0, 1500] CNY/MWh
the charge and discharge curves are independent; simultaneous charge and discharge is prevented by the physical model, not by the bid
